name: vidbyte
description: Vidbyte's plugins for Claude Code and Codex, from the home of vidbyte-cli (start hosted Research harness runs, run local Codex coding-agent teams, and get ranked next actions): setup for vidbyte-cli, and Vidbyte's agent skills in one plugin (also installable with npx skills add cerredz/vidbyte-cli).

plugins.name: vidbyte
plugins.description: Set up Vidbyte from your coding agent: install vidbyte-cli, log in without pasting your API key into the chat, and verify the account before any agent runs.

plugins.name: vidbyte-agent-skills
plugins.description: Every Vidbyte agent skill in one plugin: each teaches your coding agent to hand one engineering job to Vidbyte's agents through vidbyte-cli, such as resolving the merge conflicts on your pull requests or researching a competitor. The same skills as npx skills add cerredz/vidbyte-cli.
